yields.label: Food
yields.description: People employed in agriculture, forestry & fishing (NACE A), counted where they work (Eurostat nama_10r_3empers). United Kingdom: BRES employment (ONS, via Nomis; Great Britain only). Switzerland, Türkiye, Albania and Montenegro, which publish no regional jobs: the region’s value added in each industry ÷ the country’s value added per worker, scaled to the national total. Iceland and Liechtenstein: national figures split by population.

yields.label: Production
yields.description: People employed in industry (NACE B-E: manufacturing, mining, energy, water) and construction (F), counted where they work (Eurostat nama_10r_3empers). United Kingdom: BRES employment (ONS, via Nomis; Great Britain only). Switzerland, Türkiye, Albania and Montenegro, which publish no regional jobs: the region’s value added in each industry ÷ the country’s value added per worker, scaled to the national total. Iceland and Liechtenstein: national figures split by population.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross domestic product per year at current market prices, in euros, counted where the work is done (Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp, NUTS 3). Metro GDP is the sum of the metro region’s NUTS 3 regions. United Kingdom: ONS regional GDP (2024), converted at the year’s average pound–euro rate.
